I hit "Restore" on the design-systems bookmark in Archive, and back in All bookmarks there it is again — same title, same description, same site — sitting alongside my other bookmarks, and the Archive count cleared out. It came back as the same item, not a fresh duplicate, which is just what I'd want when I change my mind about something I'd tucked away.

That rounds out archiving nicely for me — hide, keep out of search, restore unchanged, and a separate permanent delete for the real goodbyes. What's next?
